description: Benchmark corpus v1 for neutral, amplified, ambiguous, and multi-segment cases

neutral.description: Sentences with no emotional cues, standard declarative statements

items.text: The meeting starts at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
items.notes: Standard factual statement

items.text: Please submit the report by Friday.
items.notes: Simple instruction without emotional markers

items.text: The temperature today is twenty degrees Celsius.
items.notes: Factual weather information

items.text: Dr. Johnson will see you now.
items.notes: Contains abbreviation, should not split on period

items.text: The library is open from Monday to Saturday.
items.notes: Standard informational statement

amplified.description: Sentences with clear emotional cues via punctuation, emoji, or explicit markers

items.text: I can't believe we won! 🎉🎉🎉
items.notes: Multiple exclamation marks and celebration emojis

items.text: This is absolutely terrible... I'm so disappointed.
items.notes: Ellipsis triggers sad emotion at low intensity

items.text: STOP RIGHT NOW!!! 😡
items.notes: Negative emoji triggers sad emotion

items.text: Oh my god, I'm so scared... please help me!
items.notes: Ellipsis triggers sad emotion at low intensity

items.text: Wow!!! That's incredible! 😱✨
items.notes: Exclamation mark triggers happy emotion

ambiguous.description: Sentences where emotion is unclear or mixed, requiring careful interpretation

items.text: Oh. Great. Another meeting.
items.notes: Could be sarcastic; periods after each word suggest dry delivery

items.text: I'm fine... really.
items.notes: Ellipsis suggests hesitation, 'really' implies the opposite

items.text: Sure, whatever you say.
items.notes: Could be passive-aggressive or genuinely agreeable

items.text: That's... interesting.
items.notes: Ellipsis triggers sad emotion

items.text: Well, that happened. 😐
items.notes: Neutral emoji, understated delivery

multi-segment.description: Texts with multiple sentences/segments requiring proper segmentation and per-segment emotion

items.text: Good morning! Today is a beautiful day. Let's enjoy it! 🌞
items.notes: Three segments with varying emotion

items.text: Wait... What happened? I don't understand.
items.notes: First segment has ellipsis triggering sad

items.text: Dr. Smith arrived late. The meeting had already started. He apologized profusely.
items.notes: All neutral segments

items.text: I'm so excited! 🎊 We're going to Paris! Can you believe it?!
items.notes: Mixed emotions with celebration and surprise

items.text: The results are in. It's not good news... We'll need to regroup tomorrow.
items.notes: Middle segment has ellipsis triggering sad

metadata.author: benchmark-corpus-v1
usage_notes: Each item should be run through the text-analysis service
Compare actual emotion and intensity against expected values
For multi-segment items, verify segmentation matches expected_segments
Ambiguous cases may have tolerance of ±0.2 on intensity
